title: Isolated singularities of the capillary equation with negative gravity
summary: We classify isolated singularities of classical solutions to the capillary equation with negative gravity, \[ \operatorname{div}\frac{Du}{\sqrt{1+|Du|^2}}=-u \qquad\text{in }B_R\setminus\{0\}\subset\mathbb R^n, \qquad n\ge2, \] without a priori assumptions on symmetry, sign, one-sided boundedness, or blow-up rate. Every such solution is either bounded near the puncture or tends uniformly to $+\infty$ or $-\infty$.
